## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO), which also confirms the commitment in the standards [Patent Policy](https://github.com/selfkin/standards/blob/main/PATENT-POLICY.md)
- [ ] Behaviour changes have a test; `pytest` and `python -m selfkin_ref.demo` pass locally
- [ ] Matches the drafts and vendored schemas; any interpretation choice is noted in the README
- [ ] Vendored schema files were not edited by hand
- [ ] No real keys, tokens, or personal data in code, tests, or fixtures
- [ ] [CHANGELOG.md](../CHANGELOG.md) updated
- [ ] No em dashes or en dashes
